section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as angels refine and elevate the letters of Torah and prayer from below, so too the revelations of the future require refinement through Gan Eden, ultimately revealing the essence of the mitzvah and the simple essence of Atzmus.
section.t: And one may add to this, that it is in the manner known in the explanation of “friends”
“who listen to your voice,”
“friends” are the ministering angels,
and they listen to your voice, to the voice of the Torah and prayer of Israel.
For since the voice and speech of man are physical,
therefore,
in order for the Torah and prayer of man to ascend, it is through the angels refining them,
for they “envelop them and kiss them,”
and through the angels elevating the letters of the Torah and prayer of Israel
(this is the aforementioned explanation of “who listen to your voice”),
behold, in reward for this
they “listen to your voice,” meaning that they receive from the letters of the Torah and prayer of Israel,
for they are much higher than the angels, even to an incomparable elevation,
so too is it regarding the revelations of the future to come,
that although they are incomparably higher relative to the revelations of the Garden of Eden,
nevertheless,
since the revelations of the future are the light drawn down through the performance of mitzvos in physical things in this physical and material world,
therefore they need to be refined by ascending to the Garden of Eden,
for the Garden of Eden is refined to the utmost
(as is known
the reason for this, that Adam the first man was banished from the Garden of Eden,
because the Garden of Eden cannot tolerate the existence of sin).
But now,
even after they are refined in the Garden of Eden,
behold, the essence of the mitzvah does not shine in revelation, only a radiation alone,
the “light that fills.”
And through this
(since the nature of the “light that fills” is revelation)
in the future there will be the revelation of the essence of the mitzvah,
the revelation of the “encompassing,”
and higher still,
behold, in the heavens,
the revelation of the simple essence of the Awtsmoos.
